meta.name: Jezero - surface environment reference values and scenarios
meta.note: Temperature ranges are measured values reported for MEDA on Perseverance. Pressure, dust, wind and radiation-factor values are approximate planning values or hypothetical scenarios, flagged per field. The diurnal curves, visibility and illumination are simple models in src/core/EnvironmentModel.js, not measurements.

sources.title: Daily Records of Atmospheric Temperature with Perseverance (NASA Science blog, MEDA)
Seasonal and Diurnal Variability of Atmospheric Pressure in Jezero Crater, Mars, from MEDA Measurements (arXiv:2511.09743, not peer-reviewed)
NASA's Perseverance rover reads record of ancient Mars impacts (AGU press release; geology context, dust devil imaged at Jezero)

pressure.status: approximate planning value; arXiv:2511.09743 describes the seasonal and diurnal behaviour (larger diurnal swings than Gale, dust-related thermal tides) but its abstract gives no figures

radiation.status: hypothetical scenario multipliers applied to the modeled dose-rate field

limits.status: planning thresholds chosen for this project, not a NASA standard
